facts.fact: Bayobab Zambia and Vodacom Moçambique launched on 2026-02-21 a fibre interconnection at the Zambia-Mozambique border that gives Zambia a route to subsea cables, including direct connectivity to 2Africa.
Bayobab Zambia and Vodacom Moçambique, with officials of both countries present, launched a fibre interconnection at the Zambia-Mozambique border on 2026-02-21, with infrastructure sharing.
